Home / Services

Four stages, used together or one at a time

Engage us for the whole chain from origin to delivery, or subcontract only the stage you need.

Stage 1

Sourcing and verification of supply

We identify producers, concessions and terminals that can supply your specification, and confirm that the material and the right to sell it are real before you commit.

Start with sourcing

Rare earths & minerals

Off-take from licensed operations, with baseline sampling at source.

Crude oil & products

Allocation lifting from producers, terminals and tank farms.

Gemstones

Rough parcels from licensed producers and tenders, sealed and recorded.

Stage 2

Processing to specification

Raw material is prepared to the buyer’s technical requirements before export, to improve purity, grade compliance and transport efficiency.

Send a specification

Minerals

Crushing, milling, magnetic or flotation separation and chemical processing through partner plants.

Crude & distillates

Terminal blending, water and sediment treatment, and gravity and sulphur alignment.

Gemstones

Cleaning, sorting, grading, sawing, cutting and polishing.

Stage 3

Documentation and compliance

We assemble the paperwork that customs, banks and compliance teams require. Cargo without a complete document set cannot be cleared or financed.

See the document set

Origin & permits

Certificates of origin, export licences, royalty and tax clearance.

Independent inspection

Assay, quality and quantity reports from the surveyor you appoint.

Provenance & banking

Chain-of-custody records, invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and documents formatted for letters of credit.

Stage 4

Logistics and delivery

We arrange transport on the terms you choose and keep the chain of custody intact until handover.

Discuss delivery

Tankers

Vessel chartering support, ship-to-ship coordination and discharge management.

Containers & bulk

Sealed drums and bulk bags in containers, with hazardous-goods clearance where needed.

Secured air

Courier or vault-to-vault transport for high-value stones, with insurance.

Have a requirement or an active mandate?

Tell us what you need, the quantity and where it must be delivered. We will reply with what we can and cannot do.
